```{r}
#| label: setup-xmpmulti
#| echo: false
#| cache: false

# Cached chunks do not restore hooks, so registration must run on every render.
# Render a chunk's plots as a beamer overlay via xmpmulti's \multiinclude,
# instead of quarto's \animategraphics. Opt in per chunk with
# `fig-show: animate`; the overlay spec defaults to <+> (one plot per click)
# and can be set per chunk with `overlay`.
local({
  previous_hook <- knitr::knit_hooks$get("plot")

  knitr::knit_hooks$set(
    plot = function(x, options) {
      if (!identical(options$fig.show, "animate")) {
        return(previous_hook(x, options))
      }

      # \multiinclude is emitted once, after the last plot of the chunk.
      if ((options$fig.cur %||% 1L) < options$fig.num) {
        return("")
      }

      include <- sprintf(
        "\\multiinclude[%s][format=%s,start=1,end=%d%s]{%s}",
        options$overlay %||% "<+>",
        xfun::file_ext(x),
        # `end` guards against stale figures left over from an earlier render.
        options$fig.num,
        if (is.null(options$out.width)) {
          ""
        } else {
          sprintf(",graphics={width=%s}", options$out.width)
        },
        sub(sprintf("-%d$", options$fig.num), "", xfun::sans_ext(x))
      )

      caption <- options$fig.cap

      if (is.null(caption) || is.na(caption) || !nzchar(caption)) {
        sprintf("\n\n\\begin{center}\n%s\n\\end{center}\n\n", include)
      } else {
        sprintf(
          "\n\n\\begin{figure}[htpb]\n\\centering\n%s\n\\caption{%s}\n\\end{figure}\n\n",
          include,
          caption
        )
      }
    }
  )
})
```
